title: The mass–spring–damper oscillation
caption: For m = 1 kg, c = 2 N·s/m and k = 100 N/m, ẍ + 2ẋ + 100x = 0 gives x = e^{−t} cos(√99 t) from a start at x = 1: it oscillates at √99 ≈ 9.95 rad/s, close to √100 = 10, inside the decaying envelope e^{−t}.
alt: A cosine wave of about ten radians per second starting at 1 and shrinking inside the dashed envelope e^{−t}.
description: The model is ẍ + 2ẋ + 100x = 0 with the mass displaced to x = 1.
The solution is x = e^{−t} cos(√99 t).
The oscillation has angular frequency about 10 rad/s.

checks.name: one period 2π/√99 ≈ 0.631 s later the displacement is e^{−t}
at t = 2 s the oscillation is inside the envelope ±e^{−2}
